māteria

māteria, māteriae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

the mixed mortar; subject matter, a subject to talk or write about; stuff, matter, material

In this lexicon

    also used · classical · Vitruvius 2.5.1; 2.8.2

  • subject

    the recommended word · classical · Plin. Ep. 9.33.1: incidī in māteriam vēram; Phaedr. 1 prol. 1; Traupman 32, 387, 393, 396

  • substance

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. N.D. 3.92: māteria rērum, ex quā et in quā sunt omnia (Lewis & Short); Ov. Met. 2.5: māteriam superābat opus

  • māteria chēmica: chemical

    modern

  • māteria prōpulsōria, māteriae prōpulsōriae f.: fuel

    modern

  • māteria plastica, māteriae plasticae f.: plastic

    modern
